about_the_game:
Purchasing this add-on unlocks the commentary character："Shirakami Fubuki"

Shirakami Fubuki Takes Over Treasure Mountain!?

The immensely popular hololive talent "Shirakami Fubuki",

makes an electrifying appearance in "hololive Treasure Mountain" as a new commentator character!

Her gentle and adorable commentary will make your gameplay even more exciting!

About Shirakami Fubuki's "SUKONNA DLC"

You'll be able to select the new commentary character "Shirakami Fubuki".

When you set "Shirakami Fubuki" as the commentary character,

she will appear on screen during gameplay and cheerfully provide commentary while accompanied by a brand-new Fubuki-themed BGM!

When you create "The biggest treasure,"

the special treasure voice will also change to Shirakami Fubuki's version,

and there's even a brand-new Fubuki-themed opening!

This DLC is packed full of all things Fubuki!

※You can change the commentary character from the title by selecting:

　"Marine's Treasures" > "Select Commentator".
